questions.stem: Who was the first man created by God according to the Bible?
questions.explanation: According to Genesis 2:7, Adam was the first man created by God from the dust of the ground.

questions.stem: What was the name of the garden where Adam and Eve lived?
questions.explanation: Genesis 2:8 states that God placed Adam and Eve in the Garden of Eden.

questions.stem: Who built an ark to save his family and animals from the flood?
questions.explanation: Genesis 6:14-22 describes Noah building an ark as per God’s instructions to survive the flood.

questions.stem: What was the sign of God’s covenant with Noah after the flood?
questions.explanation: Genesis 9:13 states that God set a rainbow in the sky as a sign of His covenant with Noah.

questions.stem: Who was called by God to leave his homeland and go to a promised land?
questions.explanation: Genesis 12:1 records God calling Abraham to leave his homeland for a land He would show him.

questions.stem: What was the name of Abraham’s son of promise?
questions.explanation: Genesis 21:3 states that Isaac was the son of promise born to Abraham and Sarah.

questions.stem: Who led the Israelites out of Egypt?
questions.explanation: Exodus 3:10 shows God choosing Moses to lead the Israelites out of Egypt.

questions.stem: What did God give to Moses on Mount Sinai?
questions.explanation: Exodus 20:1-17 records God giving the Ten Commandments to Moses on Mount Sinai.

questions.stem: Who was the first king of Israel?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 10:1 describes Saul as the first king anointed by Samuel for Israel.

questions.stem: Who killed Goliath with a sling and a stone?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 17:50 states that David killed Goliath using a sling and a stone.

questions.stem: What was the name of the temple built by King Solomon?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 6:1-14 describes Solomon building the Jerusalem Temple for God.

questions.stem: Who was sold into slavery by his brothers?
questions.explanation: Genesis 37:28 recounts Joseph being sold into slavery by his brothers.

questions.stem: Which prophet was taken to heaven in a chariot of fire?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 2:11 describes Elijah being taken to heaven in a chariot of fire.

questions.stem: Who was thrown into a lions’ den for praying to God?
questions.explanation: Daniel 6:16 records Daniel being thrown into the lions’ den for his faith.

questions.stem: What was the name of the queen who saved her people from destruction?
questions.explanation: Esther 7:3-6 shows Esther saving the Jews from Haman’s plot.

questions.stem: Who was the mother of Samuel the prophet?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 1:20 states that Hannah was the mother of Samuel.

questions.stem: Which prophet foretold the birth of Jesus in Bethlehem?
questions.explanation: Micah 5:2 prophesies the birth of the Messiah in Bethlehem.

questions.stem: Who was the mother of Jesus?
questions.explanation: Luke 1:31 identifies Mary as the mother of Jesus.

questions.stem: Who baptized Jesus in the River Jordan?
questions.explanation: Matthew 3:13-17 records John the Baptist baptizing Jesus in the River Jordan.

questions.stem: What was the first miracle performed by Jesus?
questions.explanation: John 2:11 describes Jesus turning water into wine at Cana as His first miracle.

questions.stem: Which disciple betrayed Jesus?
questions.explanation: Matthew 26:14-16 states that Judas Iscariot betrayed Jesus for thirty pieces of silver.

questions.stem: On what day did Jesus rise from the dead?
questions.explanation: Matthew 28:1-6 records Jesus rising from the dead on the first day of the week, Sunday.

questions.stem: What is the term for the event when Jesus ascended into heaven?
questions.explanation: Acts 1:9-11 describes the Ascension, when Jesus was taken up into heaven.

questions.stem: Who received the Holy Spirit on the day of Pentecost?
questions.explanation: Acts 2:1-4 states that the disciples received the Holy Spirit on Pentecost.

questions.stem: Who was the first Christian martyr?
questions.explanation: Acts 7:59-60 records Stephen as the first Christian martyr, stoned for his faith.

questions.stem: Who was converted on the road to Damascus?
questions.explanation: Acts 9:3-6 describes Paul’s conversion on the road to Damascus.

questions.stem: What is the term for the act of turning away from sin?
questions.explanation: Repentance is the act of turning away from sin and seeking forgiveness, as taught in Acts 3:19.

questions.stem: Which parable teaches about helping a neighbor in need?
questions.explanation: Luke 10:25-37 tells the parable of the Good Samaritan, emphasizing helping others.

questions.stem: Who denied Jesus three times before the rooster crowed?
questions.explanation: Luke 22:60-61 records Peter denying Jesus three times before the rooster crowed.

questions.stem: What is the term for God’s unmerited favor toward humanity?
questions.explanation: Grace is God’s unmerited favor, as explained in Ephesians 2:8.

questions.stem: Which book of the Bible contains the Sermon on the Mount?
questions.explanation: Matthew 5-7 records the Sermon on the Mount delivered by Jesus.

questions.stem: Who was the father of John the Baptist?
questions.explanation: Luke 1:13 identifies Zechariah as the father of John the Baptist.

questions.stem: What was the name of the sea where Jesus calmed the storm?
questions.explanation: Mark 4:39 describes Jesus calming the storm on the Sea of Galilee.

questions.stem: Which apostle was known as the 'doubting' disciple?
questions.explanation: John 20:24-27 describes Thomas doubting Jesus’ resurrection until he saw Him.

questions.stem: What is the term for the second coming of Jesus Christ?
questions.explanation: Parousia refers to the second coming of Jesus, as mentioned in Matthew 24:27.

questions.stem: Who was the king who tried to kill baby Jesus?
questions.explanation: Matthew 2:16 records Herod ordering the killing of male infants to eliminate Jesus.

questions.stem: Which parable teaches about forgiveness and God’s mercy?
questions.explanation: Luke 15:11-32 tells the parable of the Prodigal Son, highlighting God’s forgiveness.

questions.stem: Who was the first person to see Jesus after His resurrection?
questions.explanation: John 20:11-18 states that Mary Magdalene was the first to see the risen Jesus.

questions.stem: What is the term for the belief in one God?
questions.explanation: Monotheism is the belief in one God, central to Christianity (Deuteronomy 6:4).

questions.stem: Which book of the Bible contains the Lord’s Prayer?
questions.explanation: Matthew 6:9-13 records the Lord’s Prayer taught by Jesus.

questions.stem: Who was the prophet that confronted Ahab about Naboth’s vineyard?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 21:17-19 describes Elijah confronting Ahab over Naboth’s vineyard.

questions.stem: What was the name of the place where Jesus was crucified?
questions.explanation: Matthew 27:33 identifies Golgotha as the place where Jesus was crucified.

questions.stem: Who was the judge who led Israel against the Canaanites?
questions.explanation: Judges 4:4-5 describes Deborah as a judge who led Israel against the Canaanites.

questions.stem: Which disciple was a tax collector before following Jesus?
questions.explanation: Matthew 9:9 states that Matthew was a tax collector before Jesus called him.

questions.stem: What is the term for the act of being saved from sin?
questions.explanation: Salvation is the act of being saved from sin through faith in Jesus (John 3:16).

questions.stem: Who was the woman who anointed Jesus’ feet with perfume?
questions.explanation: John 12:3 describes Mary of Bethany anointing Jesus’ feet with perfume.

questions.stem: Which parable teaches about the use of talents or abilities?
questions.explanation: Matthew 25:14-30 tells the parable of the Talents, teaching stewardship of abilities.

questions.stem: Who was the father of Isaac?
questions.explanation: Genesis 21:3 identifies Abraham as the father of Isaac.

questions.stem: What was the name of the mountain where Abraham was to sacrifice Isaac?
questions.explanation: Genesis 22:2 states that God told Abraham to sacrifice Isaac on Mount Moriah.

questions.stem: Who was the prophet swallowed by a great fish?
questions.explanation: Jonah 1:17 describes Jonah being swallowed by a great fish.

questions.stem: Which commandment forbids lying?
questions.explanation: The ninth commandment, 'You shall not bear false witness,' forbids lying (Exodus 20:16).

questions.stem: Who was the first high priest of Israel?
questions.explanation: Exodus 28:1 appoints Aaron as the first high priest of Israel.

questions.stem: Which parable teaches about God’s kingdom growing like a seed?
questions.explanation: Matthew 13:31-32 describes the parable of the Mustard Seed, illustrating the kingdom’s growth.

questions.stem: Who was the Roman governor who sentenced Jesus to death?
questions.explanation: Matthew 27:26 states that Pontius Pilate sentenced Jesus to crucifixion.

questions.stem: What is the term for the belief in the resurrection of the dead?
questions.explanation: Eschatology includes the belief in the resurrection of the dead (1 Corinthians 15:22).

questions.stem: Who was the prophet who anointed David as king?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 16:13 records Samuel anointing David as king of Israel.

questions.stem: Which book of the Bible contains the Beatitudes?
questions.explanation: Matthew 5:3-12 contains the Beatitudes, part of the Sermon on the Mount.

questions.stem: Who was the wife of Isaac?
questions.explanation: Genesis 24:67 identifies Rebekah as the wife of Isaac.

questions.stem: Which disciple was chosen to replace Judas Iscariot?
questions.explanation: Acts 1:26 states that Matthias was chosen to replace Judas Iscariot.

questions.stem: What was the name of the city where Jonah was sent to preach?
questions.explanation: Jonah 1:2 records God sending Jonah to preach to the city of Nineveh.

questions.stem: Which commandment forbids stealing?
questions.explanation: The eighth commandment, 'You shall not steal,' forbids stealing (Exodus 20:15).

questions.stem: Who was the king who built the first temple in Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 6:1-14 describes Solomon building the first temple in Jerusalem.

questions.stem: Which parable teaches about persistence in prayer?
questions.explanation: Luke 18:1-8 tells the parable of the Persistent Widow, teaching persistence in prayer.

questions.stem: Who was the cousin of Jesus, according to the Bible?
questions.explanation: Luke 1:36 indicates that John the Baptist was Jesus’ cousin through Mary and Elizabeth.

questions.stem: What is the term for the act of trusting in God?
questions.explanation: Faith is the act of trusting in God, as emphasized in Hebrews 11:1.

questions.stem: Which book of the Bible contains the story of the Good Shepherd?
questions.explanation: John 10:11-14 contains Jesus’ teaching about being the Good Shepherd.

questions.stem: Who was the prophet who rebuilt the walls of Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 2:17-18 describes Nehemiah leading the rebuilding of Jerusalem’s walls.

questions.stem: Which disciple was a fisherman before following Jesus?
questions.explanation: Luke 5:10 identifies Peter as a fisherman before Jesus called him.

questions.stem: What was the name of the river where the Israelites crossed into Canaan?
questions.explanation: Joshua 3:14-17 describes the Israelites crossing the Jordan River into Canaan.

questions.stem: Which commandment emphasizes honoring parents?
questions.explanation: The fifth commandment, 'Honor your father and mother,' emphasizes respect for parents (Exodus 20:12).

questions.stem: Who was the father of Jacob and Esau?
questions.explanation: Genesis 25:26 identifies Isaac as the father of Jacob and Esau.

questions.stem: Which parable teaches about the kingdom of God being like a treasure?
questions.explanation: Matthew 13:44 describes the parable of the Hidden Treasure, likening the kingdom to a treasure.

questions.stem: Who was the king who repented after Jonah’s preaching?
questions.explanation: Jonah 3:6-10 records the King of Nineveh repenting after Jonah’s preaching.

questions.stem: What is the term for the act of giving to the poor or needy?
questions.explanation: Charity is the act of giving to the poor or needy, as encouraged in 1 Corinthians 13:3.

questions.stem: Which book of the Bible contains the story of Lazarus and the rich man?
questions.explanation: Luke 16:19-31 tells the parable of Lazarus and the rich man.

questions.stem: Who was the prophet who foretold a virgin would give birth to a son?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 7:14 prophesies a virgin giving birth to a son, fulfilled in Jesus’ birth.

questions.stem: Which disciple walked on water toward Jesus?
questions.explanation: Matthew 14:29 describes Peter walking on water toward Jesus.

questions.stem: What was the name of the city where Jesus was born?
questions.explanation: Luke 2:4-7 states that Jesus was born in Bethlehem.

questions.stem: Which commandment forbids coveting?
questions.explanation: The tenth commandment, 'You shall not covet,' forbids desiring others’ possessions (Exodus 20:17).

questions.stem: Who was the mother of Ishmael?
questions.explanation: Genesis 16:15 identifies Hagar as the mother of Ishmael.

questions.stem: Which parable teaches about the separation of the righteous and the wicked?
questions.explanation: Matthew 25:31-46 tells the parable of the Sheep and the Goats, depicting judgment.

questions.stem: Who was the prophet who performed miracles at Mount Carmel?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 18:36-39 describes Elijah’s miracles at Mount Carmel.

questions.stem: What is the term for the act of worshipping God?
questions.explanation: Adoration is the act of worshipping or giving reverence to God (Psalm 95:6).

questions.stem: Which book of the Bible contains the story of the vine and the branches?
questions.explanation: John 15:1-5 contains Jesus’ teaching about the vine and the branches.

questions.stem: Who was the king who committed adultery with Bathsheba?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 11:2-4 describes David’s adultery with Bathsheba.

questions.stem: Which disciple was known as the 'beloved disciple'?
questions.explanation: John 13:23 refers to John as the disciple whom Jesus loved.

questions.stem: What was the name of the mountain where Jesus was transfigured?
questions.explanation: Matthew 17:1-2 traditionally identifies Mount Tabor as the site of Jesus’ transfiguration.

questions.stem: Which commandment forbids murder?
questions.explanation: The sixth commandment, 'You shall not murder,' forbids killing (Exodus 20:13).

questions.stem: Who was the father of Joseph, the husband of Mary?
questions.explanation: Matthew 1:16 identifies Jacob as the father of Joseph, Mary’s husband.

questions.stem: Which parable teaches about the value of small beginnings?
questions.explanation: Matthew 13:31-32 tells the parable of the Mustard Seed, emphasizing small beginnings.

questions.stem: Who was the prophet who was fed by ravens?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 17:4-6 describes God sending ravens to feed Elijah.
